title: Circle Wrapped Bitcoin (cirBTC) on Aave Ethereum Assessments
headline: Low-information proposal
summary: This forum thread is a collection point for risk and technical assessments of cirBTC on Aave Ethereum. It is to hold the pre-listing asset risk assessment under the Aave Risk Framework, the pre-listing technical assessment under the Technical Asset Listing Framework, post-listing monitoring reports, periodic refresh assessments and re-evaluations triggered by material changes. New assessments are to be posted as replies. The opening post itself contains no proposal, parameters or amounts.
